facility.days: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Weekend Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: There was no activity plan or daily schedule.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The fire extinguisher had not been inspected monthly since 4/2024. This was corrected when it was inspected today and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §747.5107(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: Outside there was a broken scooter that could not be used. This was corrected when the equipment was thrown away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §747.3501(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Two school age children files did not have proper school information such as the name of the school or the phone number. This was corrected when the information was updated in the files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §747.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The smoke detector had not been tested monthly since 4/2024. This was corrected when it was tested today and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills have not been conducted or documented since 4/6/2024. This was corrected when a fire drill was conducted during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly: The CO detector had not been tested monthly since 4/2024. This was corrected when it was tested today and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The parents rights were no included in the policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The policies did not include the promotion of physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation: Background checks for two household members have not been submitted. The household members moved into the home in 2021. Please log into the portal and submit the required background checks today.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation (26 TAC §745.621(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The fire extinguisher is not mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -6 hours in specific topics: The primary caregiver needs to receive 6 clock hours of annual training in one or more the following topics for the September 2020-Septembber 2021 training year.  1. Child development and growth  2. Guidance and discipline  3. Age appropriate activities  4. Teacher child interaction  5. Caring for children with special needs    These 6 clock hours will be counted as make-up training hours and will not be counted towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -6 hours in specific topics (26 TAC §747.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Of the four children's records evaluated, one lacked permission for emergency medical care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: The caregiver that transports children does not have First Aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver and Substitute that transports - Transportation Training: The primary caregiver and the caregiver that transports children is not current with transportation safety training. A transportation safety course must be completed by 2/24/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver and Substitute that transports - Transportation Training (26 TAC §747.1303(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers: The telephone numbers and parent contact information for each child is not in the vehicle. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The infromation for the authorizationf or emergency medicare and treatment is not in the vehicle for each child being transported. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: A list of the children being transported is not in the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year: The child care home is not practicing lock down/shelter in place drills. These drills must be done 4 times a year and documented on the Fire Safety Practices form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The child care is not practicing fire drills. The last fire drill was conducted in March 2020. Fire drills must be conducted every month and documented on the Fire Safety Practices form. You must  conduct a fire drill by 3/9/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Of the four children's records evaluated, two did not have a health statement from their doctors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher has not been serviced within the last year. The arrow is in the red area. Please have the fire extinguisher serviced or purchase a new one.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The smoke alarm is not being tested monthly. The smoke alarm must be tested monthly to make sure it is working properly. The test must be documented on the Fire Safety Practices form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Of the four children's records evaluated, one did not have a shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
